name: Rankfender
summary: SEO and GEO platform that audits your site, publishes articles, and checks how major AI assistants talk about your brand.
description: Rankfender combines keyword research, rank tracking (including AI Overviews), competitor and backlink analysis, site audits, content and social, and checks how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Grok, Llama and Mistral answer buyer questions (via official APIs). You can work in the app or connect Claude or ChatGPT so an agent can run it. Essential covers 1 brand, 15 AI prompts weekly in 5 of 8 assistants, 5 articles a month and a site audit up to 10 pages.
features: Site audit for Google and AI engines
agent access via Claude or ChatGPT
